Initial release of agent-team-orchestration.

- Introduces structured workflows for multi-agent teams with defined roles.
- Provides clear lifecycle for tasks (inbox → assigned → in progress → review → done/failed).
- Establishes handoff protocols and review workflows to ensure quality.
- Includes guidance for managing async communication and artifact sharing between agents.
- Details common pitfalls and when not to use orchestration patterns.
